description: A single majestic broken stone pier of an ancient sky aqueduct, a restrained hand-crafted pixel art prop for a top-down 384x216 game. 64x112 native pixels; whole object on a completely transparent background. Entire pier fits canvas with empty padding. Base centered at pixel32,106. Height90 pixels, width35 at base. Lean vertically slotted monolithic blue-grey ashlar engineering; two massive unequal upright fins attached to one heavy block footing, fractured angular silhouette and one deep vertical channel, small purposeful chipped clusters at broken top. Not a statue or classical column. Upper left cool light. Large flat shadow planes with sparse cracks, no noisy texture. Palette cold #2b3548 #333b4c #46526a #64738a #94a1ae, light only tiny broken edge, broad calm shapes. Melancholy abandoned waterworks, immense old engineering. No glyphs, no moss, no glow, no vines, no cast shadow or ground. Three-quarter top-down game view with a shallow visible top plane.
